name: bus-data-interaction-budget-v2
notes: Every offline initializer is trained from scratch on its permitted complete blocks, not loaded from the full-data initializer.
World-model fit, stopping, calibration and trust learning use only the same permitted offline pool.
All source-model data come from the current branch's counted live source interactions.
Source batches are not split; actual event counts are at most the nominal budget and reported explicitly.
Same original H2O+ ratio correction and update budget in both continuation methods.
Single-factor speed, OD intensity, additional signal density and base dwell biases change source transitions; SUMO stays fixed.
Empirical running times already include baseline junction delay. Additional signal encounters represent only the excess junction density, not a second baseline delay.
OD intensity scales the OD matrix uniformly; spatial redistribution is not part of this first study.
Mechanistic disables empirical segment-runtime sampling and uses the original speed/acceleration/signal dynamics. OD, topology and dwell inputs remain unchanged.
Mismatch branches use the six-block offline pool; their final interaction budget is evaluated first.
One training seed and one new paired evaluation block per demand; this is a small budget study, not a speed benchmark or broad confirmation.
